# Northcrest Studio

> Northcrest Studio is a founder-led website studio in Calgary, Alberta, that builds websites for trades businesses: roofers, landscapers, plumbers, electricians, renovators and framers. Clients can pay once from $999 and own their site, or pay monthly from $129 (CAD, plus GST). The homepage is designed free before the client pays anything.

## Key facts
- Founder: Thomas Martinez, who personally reviews every site before launch.
- Based in Calgary, Alberta. Serves Calgary, Airdrie, Cochrane, Chestermere and Okotoks.
- Contact: call or text (587) 583-8450, email hello@northcreststudio.ca. Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm.
- First client: Hermes Framing (https://hermesframing.ca).
- Payment: card or Interac e-Transfer. All prices in CAD, plus GST.

## Websites to own (paid once)
- Trades Starter Site: $999. Up to 5 pages: services, service areas, gallery, a quote form with photo upload, and click-to-call. Live in 7 business days.
- Trades Growth Site: $1,999. 6 to 15 pages: a page per service, local SEO, Google profile setup, reviews and a before-and-after gallery. Live in 7 to 10 business days.
- Trades Business Launch Kit: $1,999. For new trades businesses: logo, a 5-page site, Google profile, business cards and QR review cards.
- Website Rescue: $999. Keeps the current site and fixes speed and mobile, builds a new homepage, and adds click-to-call, a quote form and https. Done in 3 to 5 days.
- Trades Acquisition Site: $3,999. A page for every service and every area served, and a quote form that qualifies leads.
- Care: $79 a month for hosting, backups, edits and domain renewal.

## Monthly plans
- Starter $129/month, Growth $199/month, Premium $349/month, Full System $999/month (includes managed Google and Meta ads; ad spend billed separately). 12-month minimum, then month to month.

## Google and reviews
- Google Profile Tune-Up: $149. Google Profile Pro Setup: $399. Review Starter Kit (QR review cards and a review-request text): $249.
